title: Fairness Violations and Mitigation under Covariate Shift
reasoning: The paper is a technical exploration of algorithmic fairness in machine learning, focusing on statistical parity metrics and causal domain adaptation. While it addresses 'fairness'—a topic in ethics—it treats it as a mathematical constraint for predictive modeling on tabular data (healthcare/credit scoring) and does not evaluate religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or formal ethical/moral systems.
